mypy.name: mypy
mypy.source: Owner input O1 (fallback): the owner-supplied mypy 2.3.1 environment (path not published). The pure-python repack from that tree cannot run on CPython 3.14 because mypy hard-imports the compiled-only librt package; this pin therefore runs mypy with the pinned CPython 3.13.13 interpreter that owns the verified library tree. See the internal O1 request record (not published).
mypy.deviation: Type checking executes under CPython 3.13.13 with --python-version 3.14 targeting the evidenced platform; the toolchain is hash-verified by interpreter_sha256 + manifest_sha256 and no PATH mypy is accepted.
